title: Dress Codes
summary: Common dress codes: casual (everyday), smart casual (neat but relaxed, e.g. chinos and a collared shirt), business casual (office without a suit), and formal (suits, sarees or gowns).
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
